cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Supreme Court refused to urgently list a plea alleging a 700% hike in airfares, with the bench remarking 'Don't travel by air' (The Hindu headline). The Centre said aviation rules under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam are being fast-tracked to curb fare volatility and ensure passenger protection. Who filed the plea, which routes it cites, and when it may be heard were not in the summary we read.

cards.q: Under which law is the Centre fast-tracking new aviation rules?
cards.why: The Centre told the court rules under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam are being fast-tracked.
